spring.buckling: L0/D = 2.84; guided on Ø10 spigots inside an Ø18.6 bore
spring.reverse_drive_rule: Free idler: top strand = front bottom strand = spring force / 2. In reverse the sprocket pulls the top strand, so the slack strand under the sprocket carries spring/2 − pull. It stays tight while preload > 2 × 31.2 N (pull at the 1.0 A driver limit).

ring_gear.method: Ring tooth arc thickness from the generated profile. Bound: whole normal load T/rb applied tangentially at the ring base circle. HPSTC: whole load at the highest point of single-tooth contact on the ring (involute path end minus one base pitch), tangential component, lever to each section. Face 11 mm. PETG E = 2 GPa for Hertz.

mass.basis: PETG 1.27 g/cm³ on exact solid volume (infill not modelled); steel 7.85; brass 8.5; gearmotor 195 g (Pololu); bearings 42/32 g; 608 12 g.

open_items: Printed ring-gear allowable (8 MPa) and the PETG/PA seat fits are assumptions: print a test cap and hub, run the gear at the current limit.
Pololu publishes no radial load rating for the 37D output shaft; the mesh load at the 1.0 A limit is about 81 N.
Spring rate tolerance ±10 % is assumed (distributor sheet gives none); set the preload by spring length.
Track tension, sprocket engagement and recoil come from the MuJoCo model; measure them on the built unit.
